description: pkix-lint/src/report.rs:123-138 — Severity derives PartialOrd+Ord (Info < Warn < Error < Fatal), so the filter should simply be: f.result.detail().is_some() && result_severity(f) >= min_severity. Instead the current implementation uses an explicit matches! table that omits the case (Fatal, Error): a Fatal finding is NOT returned when min_severity=Error because the pattern (Fatal(_), _) is the only wildcard for Fatal but the arm order and placement may also be correct — need to re-check. More critically, the check calls f.result.detail().is_some() redundantly (detail is Some for Warn/Error/Fatal) and the severity-filter logic is not DRY: Severity implements Ord but is not used for the comparison, so future Severity variants will silently require manual update to this table.
title: findings_at_or_above ignores Severity ordering and misses Fatal with min_severity=Error
